translation.name: Waom Yesu Wane Sigi Maep Don

content: Yesuŋo Dokoine Eŋane Kieene Saukke

Kaiwe weku mere mo Waomŋo Yuda ŋei Loloŋonge, ea wane Peada mesikei wane naso mo bomileke. Yesu eŋe iwa yale detke. Eŋine nasoine mo bomile maikane eŋe kepe iwa qeliŋgi paki Magak wano koso ariake. Oŋo naso baŋem eŋine ŋei ŋerep magukoune iwa kepeo gekoi, eŋane zok okankake. So eŋe dokoine eŋane okankake, eamo baŋ arimage, eŋine seu seu yewao sikan ongi qoeke.
Yesu eŋine so dokoine eŋe rarapko ŋara mire ne metkoi. Satanŋo Yudas, Saimon Iskariot, eŋane gipole eŋe Yesu liweka don isisi okanka more ŋaba eŋane meto birakaki maikei wane kotino don mo motke.
So Yesu eŋe iwa yale detke, Magakŋo zonom korop mo nae meteno ninge, ea eŋe mo detke. So eŋe koso iwa yale weneŋ detke, eŋe Anutu wano ŋine ketke, so eŋe koso Anutu wano zinge wayake.
Eso Yesu eŋe zakeo ŋara qelige wieki paki momo takotine solaino suaine yewa kito qokke. Pakiso sola rato ratok kebaŋino piseke.
Pakiso doku qakki simen kude maneo ketkiso kieke dokoine eŋane kieene saukki paki sola rato ratokine kebaŋino pake yewaŋo makoke ratokonge.
Yale okan one Saimon Petoro wano sariki oŋo olale rake, “Waom, ge naŋane kiene yale waka saukkenane okanmaine me?”
Rakiso Yesuŋo mainge olale rake, “Ge ukude na okanmaile iwa mi detmaine, ŋo siluŋ baŋ ŋado detlukkene.”
Petoro rake, “Ge naŋane kiene mi saukkene, ea mida so midakaka togogole!” Rakiso Yesuŋo mainge olatke, “Na geŋane kieŋone mi saukkale, yemo ge naŋane medep so ge narop maine mi gekene.”
Olatkiso Saimon Petoro ŋo rake, “Waom, kieneka weku misuk saukkene! Meteretkene so lewene weneŋ saukenom!”

Yesuŋo olale rake, “Mane eŋe doku tauyakeŋo yemo koso misuk takotke, tauyake so eŋe kineŋoka tauyake, ŋo solaine ea korop mo qelaŋan wareake, pakimo diine mida leleake. Ŋine koropŋo diŋine midadaine. Korop ŋine maine. Ŋo ŋei wekuŋo yemo maine mida.”
Yesu eŋe ŋei maŋo isikaki maikei, ea mo detke, yalinane eŋe rake, “Korop ŋine diŋine midaine libeka. Wekuŋo dirop.”

Yesu eŋe dokoine eŋane kieene saukki qoeki ea wane ŋadino momo takotine solaine ea koso biraki waki zinge ari zakeo metmetino pese ket metke. Metki paki qeson one rake, “Ŋine na musele iwa kine kine okanŋunmaile ea wane kine maine detmami me?
Ŋine kito ŋibo ŋibon so Waom nora okanmami, ea yemo maine. Onoka wane, ŋo na yeŋina gemailane maine nora okanmami.
Na ŋinane Waom so Kito ŋibo ŋibon, eso ea wane na kieŋine saukmaile, ea wane ŋine ŋidomka yale waka kie sau sauk okannagu gekei.
Noŋo numaine okanbe paki sikan ŋunmaile, ŋine yale waka ea wane rokop okane gekei.
Na ŋidanbe detpi, qelit medep maneŋo Ŋei Waominane rokop yuanka gege ea mo mi pamaike, me qelit urata mayakane biraka birakaine, maneŋo talekake eŋane rokop mi yuan kayake.
Ukude ŋine kine kine na okanmaile, ea wane kine welekatne iwa mo detkamami, ŋine yewa okan nagu gekeiwo yemo ŋine baŋ wet pese maratkaikei!

“Na korop ŋinane mi ramaile, na ŋei diawa mo ma wakon ongole eŋe detonmaile. Ŋo Anutu wane papiao iwa yale ramaike ea wane weleine welekatne wakoniake, ‘Ŋeiwa narop mere ŋara nike, oŋo zinge koso kine ma wie ŋabanane more ebene lagulok naniake.’
Na don iwa kine kine ea mi wakongi, na ukude ŋidanmailane ŋado wakoniake. Eso ŋado baŋ welekatne wakoniake, naso yewao ‘Ŋine na ma, ea mo detluknanikei, yemo iwa yale, na noŋomka yalewa gewakale!’
Na welekatne ŋidanbe detpi, ŋei mane eŋe noŋo talekawe ariki, eŋe ma kima okan kayakeŋo, na yale waka kima okannaniake, so mane eŋe na kima okan naniakeŋo, talenangi ketkole eŋe weneŋ kima okaniake.”
Yesu Eŋe Yudas Rawakonkake
Yesu eŋe don iwa raki qoeki, ea wane ŋadino asuineŋo zok manerop umareke. Paki suaineka didiwo ra wakone rake, “Na rawe detpi, ŋinane keuo ŋine maneŋo na neu ŋei ŋaba nanmami, eŋano bira naniake.”
Yale raki dokoine eŋe deeneŋo weku weku aekeu kere pora okangi, don iwa maŋane ramaike rau paki ŋaŋae metkoi.
Dokoine eŋane keuo ŋine medep mane Yesuŋo eŋane simile kamageke, ea mo Yohane eŋe Yesu wane osino metke.
Eŋe Saimon Petoroŋo eŋe lewetineŋo qesikane kait masi okanka rake, “Qesonkanom, eŋe don iwa ŋei maŋane ramaike.”
Rakiso Yohane eŋe sorodoge kere Yesu wane osino mere qesonka rake, “Waom ŋei yewa ma?”
Qesonkakiso Yesuŋo rake, “Na beret suroko qe muruge manbe neake, ŋei yewa wane ramaile.” Yale raso beret sisine mane maso suroko qe muruŋgi paki Yudas, Saimon Iskariot wane gipole mange.
Mangi nekiso, yewaoka Satanŋo Yudas wane wetino ketke. Pakiso Yesuŋo olale rake, “Kine kine okangenane wetkemaine, yewa esatkamde okannom!”
Ŋara zakeo metkoi, eŋano ŋine maneŋo Yesu eŋe daleo wane don iwa Yudas olatke ea wane kine eŋe mi detkoi.

Yudas eŋe wesi kite ware geke, yalinane dokoine natne eŋe wetke rakoi, eŋe ari peada wane ŋara mane qole sariakane Yesu eŋe olatmaike, me kine kine natne ŋei ŋerep aboŋene midaine eboniakane olatmaike.
Yudas eŋe beret neki paki, yewaoka wie arike. Pakiso goiŋ kereke.
Yesuŋo Ra Rokop Don Musele Dokoine Edange
Yudas eŋe biraone ariki, ea wane ŋadino Yesuŋo rake, “Ukude Ŋei Wawainane Gipolane kibi qelaŋanine wakonmaike, Paki eŋane ramo Anutu wane kibi qelaŋan ukude wakonmaike.
So eŋane ramore Anutu wane kibi qelaŋan wakonmaikeo yemo Anutu oŋom Ŋei Wawainane Gipolane kibi qelaŋanine wakoniake, mi azoŋgi ikopka ma wakoniake.
Medewekopne, na naso kiroine ŋinerop zok mi gekale. Ŋine na baŋ zuaŋnanikei, Yuda ŋei edangole yewaka koso siluŋ iwa ŋine ŋidanbe, “Na arikale yewaka ŋine maine mi sarikei.
Na ra rokop don mane musele ŋine ŋibonmaile, wet maep okannagu gekei, noŋo wet maep okan ŋungole yale waka ŋidomka wet maep okan nagukei.’
Ŋine wet maep oka okan nagu geu, ŋei ŋerep korop eŋe ŋune detpi naŋane dokone okanikei.”
Yesu Eŋe Petoroŋo Bisop Kayake Ea Olatke
Saimon Petoroŋo Yesu qesonka rake, “Waom, ge diao arikene me?” Rakiso Yesuŋo olatke, “Na arikale numa yewao ge maine mi mogatnane sarikene. Ŋo baŋ ŋado yemo mogatnane sarikene.”
Yale olatki Petoro qesonka rake, “Waom, na onoka wane iwaka geŋane ŋadeŋono mi sarikale? Na geŋane rawe paki seukkalane mo ewekmaile!”
Yesuŋo donine turuŋine mainge olatke, “Ge welekatne naŋane ranom paki seukkenane ewekmaine me? Na welekatne golatpe detnom, ge atak karewe na mi detkamaile, ra bisopkenom tiak bokayake.”
